title: Integrate source-bound evidence into the standard finish verification engine
rawUserRequest: 继续。按已确认的根治方案，从最新 origin/main 建立独立纠正工单：删除 ai-finish 的特殊 mandatory evidence 通道，将 sourceBoundEvidence 注入标准验证引擎；修复命令无关的假阳性测试；补齐 PR 前关键文件覆盖率预测与 CI 失败覆盖率证据；通过 focused 验证和一次 project-test 后完成完整 PR、CI、合并、关闭流程。

declaredIntent.summary: Replace three archived, unmerged corrective attempts with one source-bound finish gate that reuses the standard verification engine and predicts changed critical-file coverage before hosted CI.

outOfScope: Mutating archived Work Item evidence or branch history belonging to PR #519, #520, or #521.
Lowering total or per-critical-file coverage floors.
Weakening formatter, lint, source-bound evidence, hosted CI, or aggregate evidence gates.
Publishing a release or changing release candidate metadata.

sources.reason: Hosted #521 template-smoke evidence: all tests passed, but scripts/ai_finish.py critical coverage regressed from the green-main baseline to 84.26%, below the 85% floor.
The existing run_declared_checks engine already owns command rendering, observability, evidence persistence, ordering, and fail-closed handling.
Authoritative critical-file floors used by project-test, including the 85% scripts/ai_finish.py floor.
Latest archived replacement whose separate mandatory-check lane exposed command-order test coupling and the missing local coverage predictor.
Hosted quality execution and diagnostics upload boundary that currently omits target/coverage.json.

riskAssessment.reason: The change affects finish ordering, installed Runtime parity, PR prediction, and hosted failure evidence. A regression could either bypass source-bound evidence or block valid adopter workflows.

executionDecision.reason: The user approved the architectural correction after the three failed replacement attempts were analyzed.

preReviewWarnings: Do not copy or modify archived evidence from PR #519-#521.
Do not add a second mandatory-check execution lane or tests whose generic stub can be consumed by the wrong command.
The changed-critical coverage predictor supplements but does not replace project-test or hosted CI.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: ai-finish automatically injects sourceBoundEvidence into the standard declared-check execution list when absent, deduplicates an explicit declaration, and executes it before quality and Outcome generation.

Source-bound registration failure and command failure are fail-closed; source-bound failure prevents quality and Outcome, while a later quality failure is still reached and attributed to quality after source-bound passes.
Root and installed Runtime PR paths preserve mandatory lint and source-bound evidence while an explicitly unconfigured generic formatter remains optional.

A lightweight changed-critical coverage command selects declared tests for changed critical scripts, generates a focused coverage report, and enforces the unchanged per-file floor without claiming to replace project-test.
Hosted smoke diagnostics upload the generated coverage JSON when quality fails or succeeds, in addition to timing and log evidence.
Focused regressions, formatter, lint, source-bound evidence, governance gates, one local project-test, and all hosted PR checks pass without lowering any quality floor.
ai-finish rejects stale Contract/checkpoint bindings before declared verification, Outcome generation, or status stabilization and directs the operator to refresh the implementation checkpoint.
guidelines: Reuse the standard verification engine rather than creating a parallel mandatory-check path.
Tests must be command-aware and prove the intended downstream branch rather than accepting any mocked command failure.
Keep root and installed Runtime behavior aligned while preserving adopter-specific optional formatter configuration.
Keep critical coverage policy declarative, fail closed on missing mappings or reports, and retain existing floors.

intent.problem: Three successive archived PRs fixed symptoms but failed at different hosted boundaries. The latest implementation duplicated the standard verification engine with a special mandatory source-bound lane. That changed command order, allowed generic test stubs to intercept the wrong check, increased critical-file statements, and escaped local lightweight validation because no focused critical-coverage predictor existed.
constraints: Start independently from the exact latest origin/main and preserve failed PRs as audit evidence until a successful replacement closes.
Do not weaken source-bound evidence, lint, formatter, coverage, hosted CI, or archive immutability.
Use focused checks during implementation and run project-test once before archive because scripts/ai_finish.py is lifecycle-critical.
Keep release execution blocked until this corrective lifecycle is merged and closed.
intent.rationale: Injecting a mandatory registered check into the existing ordered verification list removes duplicated control flow and makes all checks share one evidence and failure model. Command-aware tests prevent false positives. A changed-critical predictor catches the same class of coverage regression before hosted CI, while one authoritative project-test remains the final local coverage proof.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized efficiency exception: run focused checks and one project-test instead of the complete local quality graph; hosted CI remains mandatory.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly approved continuing the architectural root correction and has authorized the planned corrective Work Items.

rollbackNote: Revert this replacement Work Item as one unit; retain the archived evidence and failed PRs for #519-#521.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The active Contract omits sourceBoundEvidence from verification.
scenarioCoverage.expected: ai-finish injects the registered check exactly once before quality and Outcome generation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a failing integration regression around ai_finish.main, then implement standard-list injection and verify exact command order.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: sourceBoundEvidence passes and the required quality or project check fails.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The downstream check executes, owns the failure evidence, and no Outcome is generated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use command-aware test doubles that pass source-bound and fail only the named downstream command.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A lifecycle-critical script changes but focused tests do not meet its existing per-file coverage floor.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The lightweight changed-critical coverage predictor fails before PR creation and identifies the exact file, observed percentage, and unchanged floor.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Create policy and CLI regressions with controlled git diff and coverage fixtures, then run the real predictor for scripts/ai_finish.py.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Hosted smoke diagnostics are collected after repository quality succeeds or fails.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The always-running smoke artifact upload includes target/coverage.json together with timing and repository logs.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add workflow architecture regression for the always-running upload step and inspect the hosted PR artifact after execution.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An installed generic adopter has no configured formatter or linter.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The unconfigured project tools are skipped explicitly; source-bound evidence and PR ownership checks remain enforced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run installed Runtime parity and installer regressions, then require hosted installation-smoke.
